title: Make the refund retry pay each refund once

blocks.text: The shop's back office sends refunds to the refund service over a link that sometimes loses a reply: the service did the work, but the answer never came back. Finance found orders refunded twice in the weeks the link was flaky. Support has the opposite complaint: a customer who returned two identical items got one refund. And the back office's screen sometimes shows "already processed" where agents expect a receipt number to give the customer.

items: `RefundService.handle(...)`: the service's side of one request;
`RefundClient.refund(...)`: the back office's side, sending and retrying.

blocks.text: When you're done, a refund is paid once however many times the link had to ask, two refunds the back office asked for separately are both paid, and the back office always gets the receipt of the refund that was paid. About twelve lines in total.
The tests use a link that delivers every request and can drop the reply.

cases.says: a refund whose reply arrives is paid once and its receipt returned
refunds on different orders are each paid
when no attempt gets a reply, the client gives up with NoReplyException after its last attempt
a refund whose first reply is lost is asked for again and still paid once
two separate refunds of the same amount on the same order are both paid
the retry after a lost reply returns the receipt of the refund that was paid

origin.section: An Idempotency Key Created With the Command Makes the Retry Safe

concepts: An idempotency key is created once per request and reused on every attempt; a key per attempt protects nothing.
Deduplicating by content merges two real requests that happen to be equal.
The receiver returns the stored result for a repeated key, because the caller retrying never saw the first answer.
